import sys
def main():
    data=sys.stdin.read().split()
    t=int(data[0]); p=1
    out=[]
    for _ in range(t):
        n=int(data[p]); p+=1
        a=data[p:p+n]; p+=n
        runs=[]
        for x in a:
            if not runs or runs[-1]!=x:
                runs.append(x)
        out.append(str(len(runs)))
    print("\n".join(out))
main()
